title: Tactical steps handle incomplete work gracefully

brief.why: bon step is binary — done or not. Real work has steps that are blocked on external action (manual test, waiting for human) or where the final step shouldn't auto-complete the action. Users hesitate or work around with bon wait, which clears all tactical state.
brief.what: 1. bon step --skip 'reason' — advance past a step without completing it, recording why 2. bon step --no-complete on final step — prevent auto-completing the parent action 3. Skipped steps shown distinctly in bon work --status and bon show
brief.done: Can skip a step with a reason, see it marked as skipped in status output, and prevent final-step auto-complete. 6-step tactical where step 6 is a manual test can be parked without losing steps 1-5 progress.

title: Bon CLI guides Claudes to the right command on first try

brief.why: 5% of 2,542 Claude bon commands fail. Most failures — type confusion (10+), invented flags (8), step amnesia (8) — could be caught by better CLI responses: suggesting alternatives, aliasing training priors, showing context in errors.
brief.what: 1. Alias --parent to --outcome in bon new and bon edit 2. bon work on outcome auto-lists children and suggests creating one 3. bon step with no tactical suggests last-worked action 4. Add --note to bon done 5. Better missing-brief error shows what was provided
brief.done: Re-run ergonomics extraction against new sessions. bon work/step/new error rate under 1%.

done_note: All 4 child actions implemented. Item 5 (better missing-brief error) was not filed. Ergonomics re-extraction deferred to future sessions.

brief.why: After bon step --no-complete, all steps show ✓ but the action is still open. bon work --status shows checkmarks with no indication this is deliberate. Could be confusing without context.
brief.what: Add a status line to format_tactical output when current >= len(steps) and action is still open, e.g. 'All steps done — action left open (--no-complete)'
brief.done: bon work --status on a no-completed action shows the deliberate-open indicator.

title: Add --note flag to bon done for completion context

brief.why: Claude keeps inventing --resolution and --note on bon done — it wants to record why something was completed. This is a real user need: 'done because X' is valuable context for handoffs and log review.
brief.what: 1. Add optional --note flag to bon done 2. Store in activity log entry (updated_by: done, note: text) 3. Display in bon log output 4. Tests for done with and without note
brief.done: bon done ID --note 'reason' stores note in log. bon log shows it. Existing bon done without --note still works.

title: bon work on outcome auto-lists children and suggests next step

brief.why: The #1 error across both machines (10+ incidents, 6 projects). Claude maps 'work on this' to bon work, but outcomes aren't workable. The error message already suggests alternatives — but it could go further by showing which children are available and offering to create one.
brief.what: 1. When bon work is called on an outcome with actions, list open actions with IDs 2. When called on an outcome with no actions, suggest bon new --for 3. Keep the error exit code so scripts still detect failure
brief.done: bon work on outcome shows open children by ID. bon work on childless outcome suggests creation command. Both still exit 1.

title: Draw-down suggests actions ranked by loaded context, not just list order

brief.why: When /open presents ready work, the choice of what to work on next should be informed by what's already in Claude's context window — files read, modules understood, recent edits. Currently the skill just lists ready items in bon order. A Claude that just read state-builder.ts and all client modules should naturally gravitate toward actions touching those files, not start cold on something unrelated.
brief.what: 1. Add guidance to the bon skill's session-start protocol: after presenting ready items, assess which align with already-loaded context 2. Rank suggestions by context proximity — 'these are closest to what you've already read' 3. Keep it advisory, not mechanical — Claude explains why certain items are lower-friction given current context 4. Update the /open skill's Decide phase to prompt this assessment
brief.done: After /open, Claude presents ready work with context-proximity reasoning — 'these are closest to what I already have loaded' — and the user can make an informed choice without manually cross-referencing.

brief.why: cmd_log shows updated events with ~ icon but doesn't say what changed (title edit vs tactical clear vs wait). All mutations look identical in the feed.
brief.what: 1. Add a verb or context field to updated_at tracking (e.g. updated_by_command) 2. Display in cmd_log output (e.g. '~ edited title' vs '~ cleared tactical') 3. Update cmd_show to surface what changed
brief.done: bon log shows distinct verbs for different mutation types. A user can tell what happened without reading items.jsonl.

title: bon list --ready includes done items in output

brief.why: Causes confusion — users see completed actions listed as ready work, leading to attempts to close already-closed items or pick up finished work
brief.what: 1. In the ready filter logic, exclude items with status 'done' 2. Add test: create outcome with mix of open and done actions, verify --ready only shows open ones
brief.done: bon list --ready omits done items. Test confirms.

title: bon step with no tactical suggests last-worked action

brief.why: 8 incidents of 'no steps in progress' — Claude runs bon step at session boundaries without re-initializing tactical. Currently the error just says 'run bon work <id> first' with no hint which action was last active.
brief.what: 1. Track last-worked action ID (already in updated_by/log) 2. On 'no steps' error, look up most recently stepped action and suggest bon work <id> 3. Fall back to current message if no history
brief.done: bon step with no active tactical shows 'No steps in progress. Last worked: <id> (<title>). Run bon work <id> to resume.'

title: bon doctor command for file health checks

brief.why: No way to validate items.jsonl integrity beyond load-time checks. updated_by verbs aren't validated against a known set. Hand-edits or merge artifacts could introduce invalid state silently.
brief.what: 1. bon doctor command that checks items.jsonl for schema issues 2. Validate updated_by against known verb set (edited, waited, unwaited, worked, stepped, cleared, archived, converted, reopened) 3. Check for orphaned parents, duplicate IDs, missing required fields
brief.done: bon doctor reports issues found or 'all clear'. Invalid updated_by verbs flagged. Orphaned parents flagged.

title: Add common mistakes and shell escaping warnings to SKILL.md

brief.why: 8 invented-flag incidents (--parent, bon add, -t/-p, --resolution, --dir) and 4 separate sessions hitting the same \\!= shell escaping bug in inline python. These are predictable, recurring errors that a warning section would prevent.
brief.what: 1. Add Common Mistakes table: --parent→--outcome, bon add→bon new, -t/-p don't exist, --resolution doesn't exist, --dir doesn't exist 2. Add shell escaping warning: use heredoc for inline python, never double-quoted strings with \!= 3. Add parallel bon new warning: create items sequentially, not in parallel tool calls
brief.done: SKILL.md has Common Mistakes section covering flag aliases, nonexistent commands, shell escaping, and parallel creation. Each mistake shows what Claude types vs what to use.

title: Claudes re-present bon list output instead of leaving users blind

brief.why: 44% of bon list calls (49 of 111) leave the user blind — Claude sees the output but doesn't re-present it, and CC collapses Bash output >10 lines. Current SKILL.md 'never run bon list' instruction is ignored 4.6% of all commands.
brief.what: 1. PostToolUse hook: detect bon list in Bash output, inject reminder to re-present items as text 2. Replace negative skill instruction with positive alternative: concrete snippet to read bon.txt and output hierarchy 3. Verify hook fires correctly on bon list but not bon show/step/etc
brief.done: Hook deployed in ~/.claude/settings.json. After 20+ sessions, blind rate drops from 44% to under 15%.

brief.done: --parent works identically to --outcome in bon new and bon edit. Tests pass. --help lists it.

brief.what: 1. bon step <id> resolves item globally across projects 2. CWD mismatch warning when bon step targets a different project 3. bon work --status shows which CWD/project owns the active tactical
